additional_original_obligations.title: Nullable style names
additional_original_obligations.assertion: On every concrete style type, absent name reads null, string assignment writes exact supplied value, null removes name, inherited BaseStyle signatures remain nullable.

executed_original_tests.title: retains nullable names and IDs across every style class

additional_original_obligations.title: Nullable style IDs
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Absent style_id reads null; replacing an ID works; null removes existing ID and is a no-op when absent. Publication may reject incomplete identity independently.

executed_original_tests.title: retains nullable names and IDs across every style class

additional_original_obligations.title: Default style document order
additional_original_obligations.assertion: When an admitted model contains two default definitions of one type, default(type) selects the last; wrong-type/missing ID uses that result; no default returns null.

executed_original_tests.title: chooses the last type default and distinguishes lookup fallback from invalid assignment

additional_original_obligations.title: Name setter versus collection alias conversion
additional_original_obligations.assertion: add_style and add_latent_style normalize exactly the 12 built-in aliases; arbitrary names remain exact; name setter preserves supplied text. Explicitly reconcile any target difference.

executed_original_tests.title: retains empty and ordered defined collections and all built-in name aliases

additional_original_obligations.title: Style class ownership and inherited surface
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Character inherits Base; Paragraph inherits Character; Table inherits Paragraph; Numbering inherits Base only; bounded element/part/equals available without raw dependency XML constructors.

executed_original_tests.title: constructs each style type with its actual inherited formatting interfaces

additional_original_obligations.title: Concrete and latent metadata semantics
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Concrete false/null removes its UI flag child; Font explicit false remains represented; latent override null inherits, default boolean absent reads false; familiar name does not determine builtin.

executed_original_tests.title: reads every concrete %s lexical state on all inherited style classes

additional_original_obligations.title: Duplicate latent entry collection behavior
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Source add appends duplicate names and keyed lookup returns first; CLI rejects ambiguous mutation selections. Test or explicitly reconcile this model/CLI distinction.

executed_original_tests.title: keeps duplicate latent entries distinct while named lookup returns the first

additional_original_obligations.title: Empty latent container preservation
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Adding first exception to a container carrying an unknown qualified attribute preserves that attribute, namespace meaning, known count and body bytes instead of raising unsupported-edit.

executed_original_tests.title: retains extension attributes when adding to an empty latent container

additional_original_obligations.title: Imported style namespace context
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Read and edit existing qualified run/paragraph properties when prefixes are inherited only from styles root; preserve unknown namespace attributes.

executed_original_tests.title: reads and edits imported formatting with inherited namespace bindings

additional_original_obligations.title: Tab handle across unrelated mutation
additional_original_obligations.assertion: A tab handle remains valid after changing paragraph keep_with_next or another unrelated property; actual removal invalidates it.

executed_original_tests.title: keeps tab handles live across unrelated paragraph edits and preserves opaque stop attributes

additional_original_obligations.title: Latent identity across deletion and recreation
additional_original_obligations.assertion: All old latent handle properties fail after deletion, including name; recreate same name through same or another wrapper never resurrects the old handle.

executed_original_tests.title: invalidates every latent handle after another wrapper deletes and recreates its name

additional_original_obligations.title: Absent versus explicit empty style name
additional_original_obligations.assertion: A style with no name never matches the empty-string key; an explicit empty name remains a distinct string value.

executed_original_tests.title: distinguishes absent style names from explicit empty names during keyed lookup

additional_original_obligations.title: Delete applied definition and save preserved content
additional_original_obligations.assertion: Deleting a definition leaves its applied pStyle reference and text intact; saving supports documented default fallback instead of rejecting the missing definition.

executed_original_tests.title: deletes only a definition and invalidates all previously issued handles
